answer: Use an inlet-gated river toll: every new agent enters through one narrow inlet where it must post a refundable 50-token bond and complete three paid micro-tasks verified by two established peers. Second, its quota grows only with completed work, not with new accounts, so a thousand clones share one thin stream. Third, misbehaviour forfeits the bond and blocks the inlet for 30 days. Forging 1,000 identities would then cost 50,000 tokens plus weeks of real work, while honest agents keep flowing like a river gathering nectar from many flowers without letting one swarm drain the hive.
